title: Export your clients from Jobber
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export your clients from Jobber as a CSV file. You'll need an admin account.

capture.what: Jobber dashboard, signed in to the demo account. Cursor rests on the side navigation.

scenes.narration: Click Clients in the side navigation.
In the top right corner, click More Actions, then choose Export Clients.

capture.what: Click More Actions, then Export Clients.

scenes.narration: Under Choose export format, select CSV, then click Export.

capture.what: Select CSV, click Export. Show Jobber's confirmation.

scenes.narration: Jobber emails you the file. A large list may arrive as several files: download each one.

capture.what: Demo mailbox: open Jobber's email, click the CSV attachment or link, show the download.

scenes.narration: Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.

capture.what: Show the downloaded .csv in the browser's download list.
